name: nebula-vault-frontend-tools
description: Formatting and validation tools for Nebula Vault's Django front end

scripts.format:templates: find templates accounts/templates blog/templates comment/templates -type f -name '*.html' ! -path 'templates/admin/*' ! -path 'templates/registration/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -r djlint --reformat --profile=django --indent=2
scripts.format: npm run format:assets && npm run format:templates
scripts.check:templates: find templates accounts/templates blog/templates comment/templates -type f -name '*.html' ! -path 'templates/admin/*' ! -path 'templates/registration/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -r djlint --check --profile=django --indent=2
scripts.check:js: find static/portal/js accounts/static -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n 1 node --check && node --check static/portal/service-worker.js
scripts.check:frontend: npm run check:assets && npm run check:templates && npm run check:js
